name: Kannagi
source:
Two families with psychic abilities fight each other since ancient times.
Main character is from one of those families. He is brought up as a God. His human part gradually fades away, but continues to pursue him. Unknown past, mysterious child and woman that must have died.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-march-2002-kikokugai-cyber.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
自古以来，两个拥有灵能力量的家族便彼此争斗。
主人公出身于其中一个家族，被当作神明抚养长大。他身为人的一面逐渐消退，却仍不断追寻着他。未知的过去、神秘的孩子，以及本应已经死去的女人。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-march-2002-kikokugai-cyber.html]vndbreview[/url]]
